issues.license: public (no explicit license field on the trajectory dataset itself)

trajectories.license_status: unresolved — no explicit license field exposed via dataset API

raw_record_schema.instance_id: SWE-bench Verified instance id (joined against princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified test split)
raw_record_schema.reward: binary pass/fail of the evaluation harness: 1.0 = all tests passed, 0.0 = failed
raw_record_schema.messages: OpenAI-style chat transcript produced by CoderForge-Preview-32B
raw_record_schema.output_patch: unified-diff patch emitted by the agent at end of trajectory
raw_record_schema.verified_issue: joined metadata from SWE-bench_Verified (problem_statement, hints_text, repo, base_commit, test_patch, patch)

label_semantics.reward_binarization_convention: reward < 1.0 -> trace_incident=1 (matches metrics TR-20260418-001 convention: failure is the positive class for detection)

per_detector_mapping: NONE. CoderForge reward is run-level pass/fail only; it does not distinguish which behavioral-health category caused the failure. Use run-level flag-frequency analysis, not per-detector confusion matrix.
scope_note: The metrics TR-20260418-001 feature table has 550 swe_bench rows because it concatenates 500 CoderForge trajectories with 50 pre-pivot SWE-smith-trajectory rows from TR-20260417-001. Sprint 22 scope is CoderForge-only, so we stage 500 rows, not 550.
